aspect: Soldiers are not trained to arrest people
description: Military doctrine is built around defeating an enemy, not gathering evidence and preserving a chain of custody, and the outcomes differ accordingly.
energy_note: Trained to win, deployed to arrest.

description: Where soldiers are investigated at all, the process has historically run through military channels, which is the structure described in assets/text/abuse as POL-005.

aspect: The checkpoint is the routine encounter
description: Young men are stopped, searched and questioned at military and National Guard checkpoints as an ordinary condition of travel in much of the country.
energy_note: Searched on the way to work, by an army.

description: Eighteen-year-old soldier, rifle across his chest, asking him to step out. He puts his hands on the hot metal without being told, because he has done this before and knows it shortens it. The soldier is younger than his son.
energy_note: Knows the posture that makes it end faster.
